rubrics_metrics.description: Power outputs: 2.0-litre producing 82 kW (111 PS; 110 bhp); 2.4-litre producing 100 kW (136 PS; 134 bhp); 2.5-litre diesel providing 75 kW (102 PS; 101 bhp).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dimensions — wheelbase / length / width / height
rubrics_metrics.description: Wheelbase: 112.2 in (2.85 m); Length: 185.4 in (4.71 m); Width: 73.6 in (1.87 m); Height: 71.7 in (1.82 m).

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch price / pricing range
rubrics_metrics.description: The SCEO was launched in China in 2005, which was sold at 123,800-159,800 yuan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial pricing positions the vehicle in the market (value proposition) and is useful for historical market analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Export / market distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: The SCEO was exported to more than 30 countries, according to a company report in 2006.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates international reach; relevant for analyzing regulatory exposure, importers, and regional variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model codename
rubrics_metrics.description: The Shuanghuan SCEO's codename is known as the HBJ6474Y.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Internal/model codename useful for regulatory filings, parts cataloging, and technical documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design resemblance / copying allegations
rubrics_metrics.description: The company has copied the looks of the Toyota Land Cruiser Prado (inside and at the front end), the BMW X5 (E53) at the rear end, and the BMW X3 at the sides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allegations about styling imitation are central to intellectual-property and reputational assessments; the article cites multiple sources discussing these claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal rulings and market bans (BMW copy claim)
rubrics_metrics.description: In June 2008, the Regional Court of Munich ruled that the Chinese SUV brand, 'Shuang-huan SCEO' is a copy of the BMW X5, prohibited the defendant importer of these vehicles in the 'trade in Germany' offer and ordered the destruction of all 'vehicles with a certain look' at which the defendant's possession or ownership (Az.: 4HK O 16807/07). Following a court case in Germany brought by BMW, the car was banned from sale in Germany. It was sold in Italy and central Europe, following BMW losing its court case in Italy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes concrete legal outcomes relevant to market access, IP enforcement, and importer liability; includes divergent outcomes across jurisdictions (Germany vs Italy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publicity / controversy context
rubrics_metrics.description: The SCEO's design was the cause of many disputes when the company wanted to show it at the Frankfurt Motor Show in 2007.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual information about public and media reaction that affected the model's reputation and exhibition opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference / citation practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Article lists references (Car and Driver, The New York Times, Automotive News, manufacturer pages) for specifications, history and legal coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates reliance on secondary sources; readers should verify claims via cited references for accuracy and updates.
